scenario: a misunderstanding or problem involving appointments & schedules
english_title: Recognising and Responding to a Misunderstanding or Problem Involving Appointments and Schedules
vietnamese_title: Giao tiếp nền tảng: appointments & schedules — a misunderstanding or problem involving appointments & schedules
primary_communication_goal: recognise and respond to a misunderstanding or problem involving appointments & schedules; complete the exchange naturally at A0 / Pre-A1.
context_note_en: Ms Lan tells Mr David she thinks her appointment is double-booked.
context_note_vi: Chị Lan nói với anh David hình như lịch hẹn của mình bị trùng.

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.english: Excuse me, David. I think my appointment is double-booked.
turns.vietnamese: Xin lỗi anh David. Hình như lịch hẹn của tôi bị trùng rồi.

turns.speaker: Mr David
turns.english: Oh, let me look into that.
turns.vietnamese: Ồ, để tôi kiểm tra lại.

turns.speaker: Mr David
turns.english: I am sorry for the mix-up.
turns.vietnamese: Tôi xin lỗi vì sự nhầm lẫn này.
